stem: When demonstrating a task to a peer, which approach best supports consistent execution?
choices: Show only the fastest personal technique
Use the current controlled instruction, demonstrate critical steps, explain why they matter, observe execution, and distinguish requirements from preferences
Avoid questions so the demonstration stays short
Sign off the peer as fully trained regardless of delegated authority
rationale: Effective peer support anchors demonstration to controlled work, critical steps, observation, and role boundaries rather than personal habit or unauthorized training sign-off.
